explication: EhViewer is an Android browser for E-Hentai. The user-facing journey is to search or browse galleries, open a gallery and read its images, with downloads available for offline use. The app also documents archive downloads, torrent downloads, local-album import, and Wi-Fi download migration. The tree and excerpts show client/parser, download, and native image-decoding components, but do not expose every UI-to-service call; unverified workflow links are therefore dashed and uncited.
